annotations.title: Save lessons learned from an interview

description: Requires techjobs.vn sign-in. Records the user's lessons learned for an interview round, or for a whole application: questions asked, what went well, what to improve, red flags, what to prepare next, a 1-5 confidence and improvement tags. There is one entry per round; saving again updates it, and only the fields you pass change. Save what the user said; the round's time and result belong in log_interview.

application_id.description: Apply Tracker entry id from list_applications.

clear_fields.description: Fields to remove, by name, e.g. ["red_flags"]. Tags are cleared by passing tags: [].

confidence.description: How the user feels it went, 1-5. Omit to keep it; clear it with clear_fields.

interview_id.description: The round these lessons are about (id from list_interviews). Omit for lessons about the whole application.

my_answers.description: How the user answered, in their own words. Omit to keep the current text; an empty string clears it.

next_prep.description: What to prepare before the next round. Omit to keep the current text; an empty string clears it.

questions_asked.description: The questions the interviewers asked. Omit to keep the current text; an empty string clears it.

red_flags.description: Worries about the company or role. Omit to keep the current text; an empty string clears it.

surprises.description: Anything unexpected about the company, role or process. Omit to keep the current text; an empty string clears it.

tags.description: Areas to improve (replaces the current tags). Pass [] to clear.

to_improve.description: What to do better next time. Omit to keep the current text; an empty string clears it.

went_well.description: What went well. Omit to keep the current text; an empty string clears it.

name: save_interview_retro
title: Save lessons learned from an interview
